capabilities.description: Ingests, parses, and governs the contract excerpt (document:harbourline_contract.pdf) and the priced BOQ (document:harbourline_boq.xlsx) as immutable sources of record, exposing contract parameters such as the 730-day Time for Completion, 0.1%/day delay damages with a 10% cap, 5% retention, and 10%

Prepares and certifies progress claims against the BOQ source of record, valuing measured work by item and rate, applying 5% retention per Interim Payment Certificate, and releasing retention 50% at Taking-Over and 50% at the end of the Defects Notification Period as required by the contract.

Tracks the contractual Time for Completion (730 days from Commencement Date) against actual progress, computes delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day of delay, and enforces the 10% contract cap, surfacing exposure to the contract administrator.

Captures and governs QA inspection and test plan records — inspection requests, hold points, test results, and sign-offs — linked to contract requirements and BOQ scope items, with evidence capture and immutable audit trail.
Maintains a controlled document register for the project with version control, provenance, and audit history, covering contract, BOQ, drawings, ITP records, and claim submissions.
Tracks the 365-day Defects Notification Period from Taking-Over and the 10% performance security obligation, including milestone dates, release events, and alerts.
